Policy / Instrument: UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)
Key target / provision: Stabilise GHG concentrations; no binding numeric target. Ireland signed 1992, ratified 1994.
Trade-offs / notes: Sets reporting obligations (national inventories) that anchor all later targets.

Key target / provision: Ireland permitted +13% above 1990 over 2008–2012 (within EU burden-sharing). In force 2005.
Trade-offs / notes: Generous allowance reflected expected growth; weak constraint during Celtic Tiger.

Key target / provision: First national strategy; sectoral measures toward Kyoto. Reviewed 2002.
Status / outcome: Largely missed; emissions rose ~31% above 1990 by 2001
Trade-offs / notes: Weak implementation during rapid economic growth.

Key target / provision: Cap-and-trade on ~large installations; operational from 2005.
Status / outcome: Operational; emissions in ETS sector declining
Trade-offs / notes: Covers only large emitters — leaves agriculture & transport to national effort.

Key target / provision: Review setting out route to Kyoto compliance; basis for 2007 strategy.
Trade-offs / notes: Signalled reliance on flexible mechanisms / carbon purchasing.

Key target / provision: Sectoral measures to meet Kyoto target; first adaptation section.
Status / outcome: Emissions fell mainly via 2008 recession, not policy
Trade-offs / notes: Hard to disentangle policy effect from economic crash.

Key target / provision: Established Carbon Fund to buy Kyoto units to meet international obligations.
Trade-offs / notes: Compliance via offsets rather than domestic abatement.

Policy / Instrument: 2020 Climate & Energy Package — Effort Sharing Decision 406/2009
Key target / provision: Ireland: −20% non-ETS emissions by 2020 vs 2005, with annual limits.
Status / outcome: Missed via domestic action; ~5.7% delivered, used flexibilities
Trade-offs / notes: Exposed structural difficulty cutting agriculture & transport.

Key target / provision: Ireland: 16% of gross final energy from renewables by 2020.
Trade-offs / notes: Slow build-out of wind & heat renewables.

Key target / provision: Tax on CO2 of non-ETS fuels; legislated trajectory to €100/tonne by 2030; revenue ring-fenced.
Trade-offs / notes: Regressive risk — mitigated by revenue recycling / just-transition spend.

Key target / provision: Expansion of dairy & beef output and exports.
Trade-offs / notes: Key policy CONFLICT: growth strategy works against climate targets.

Key target / provision: First national adaptation framework.
Trade-offs / notes: Complements but does not reduce emissions directly.

Key target / provision: End of milk quotas effective 2015; enabled dairy expansion.
Trade-offs / notes: Strong driver of Irish agricultural emissions growth.

Key target / provision: Limit warming to well below 2°C, pursue 1.5°C; NDCs. Adopted 2015; EU & Ireland ratified 2016.
Trade-offs / notes: Anchors the 1.5°C framing of Irish carbon budgets.

Policy / Instrument: Climate Action & Low Carbon Development Act 2015
Key target / provision: First Irish climate law; created Climate Change Advisory Council; National Policy Position (−80% CO2 by 2050 in energy/built/transport; carbon-neutral agriculture & land use).
Status / outcome: Framework in place; criticised as non-binding on targets
Trade-offs / notes: Lacked enforceable interim targets — fixed in 2021 amendment.

Key target / provision: Continued agri-food export expansion to 2025.
Status / outcome: Associated with further emissions & water-quality pressure
Trade-offs / notes: Reinforced the agriculture–climate trade-off.

Key target / provision: First statutory mitigation plan under the 2015 Act.
Status / outcome: Quashed by Supreme Court (2020, 'Climate Case Ireland') as too vague
Trade-offs / notes: Landmark legal driver that forced stronger 2021 legislation.

Key target / provision: Ireland: −30% non-ETS by 2030 vs 2005 (later revised to −42%).
Trade-offs / notes: Drives the bulk of Ireland's domestic effort.

Key target / provision: EU 32% renewables by 2030; sectoral sub-targets (transport, heat).
Status / outcome: Transposed; national RES target later raised
Trade-offs / notes: Superseded by RED III ambition.

Policy / Instrument: Governance of the Energy Union Regulation (EU) 2018/1999
Key target / provision: Requires Member States to submit National Energy & Climate Plans (NECPs).
Trade-offs / notes: Creates the planning architecture linking EU & national targets.

Key target / provision: Long-term capital plan with climate-action allocations.
Trade-offs / notes: Investment can lock in or reduce emissions depending on project mix.

Key target / provision: Roadmap to EU climate neutrality by 2050; spawned Fit for 55, REPowerEU, Green Deal Industrial Plan.
Trade-offs / notes: Umbrella under which binding EU laws were enacted.

Key target / provision: First detailed CAP; >180 actions; non-statutory.
Status / outcome: Partially implemented; superseded by statutory CAPs
Trade-offs / notes: Set template for later annual plans.

Key target / provision: First NECP; committed to ~7% average annual emissions cut 2021–2030.
Trade-offs / notes: Translates EU governance regulation into national trajectory.

Key target / provision: Friends of the Irish Environment v Government; quashed 2017 National Mitigation Plan (decided July 2020).
Trade-offs / notes: Demonstrated litigation as a policy driver.

Key target / provision: Committed to 7% average annual emissions reduction and stronger climate law.
Trade-offs / notes: Raised ambition above the then-current EU effort-sharing path.

Key target / provision: Roadmap toward climate neutrality for agriculture; 'living document'.
Trade-offs / notes: First clear pivot of agri-policy toward emissions reduction.

Key target / provision: Legally binds EU to net-zero by 2050 and net −55% by 2030 vs 1990.
Trade-offs / notes: Raised the EU-wide target that flows into Ireland's obligations.

Key target / provision: 13+ revised laws to hit −55% by 2030: revised ESR (Ireland −42% vs 2005), LULUCF (EU 310 Mt net removals), ETS reform, ETS2 (buildings & road transport, 2027), CBAM (from 2026), RED III.
Trade-offs / notes: Tightens Ireland's 2030 obligation from −30% to −42%.

Policy / Instrument: Climate Action & Low Carbon Development (Amendment) Act 2021
Key target / provision: National climate objective: climate-neutral economy by 2050; −51% by 2030 vs 2018; 5-yr carbon budgets; sectoral emissions ceilings. Commenced Sep 2021.
Status / outcome: Cornerstone law; binding governance in place
Trade-offs / notes: Projections still show ~29% vs 51% — implementation gap.

Key target / provision: First CAP under the 2021 Act; sectoral pathways to −51% by 2030.
Trade-offs / notes: Bridge to legally binding budgets adopted in 2022.

Key target / provision: 10-yr agri-food strategy; aims for a climate-neutral food system.
Trade-offs / notes: Reframes earlier growth-first strategies toward sustainability, but tensions remain.

Key target / provision: Carbon budgets effective Apr 2022 (2021–25; 2026–30; 2031–35); sectoral ceilings adopted Jul 2022 (e.g. agriculture −25% by 2030).
Trade-offs / notes: First time sectors hold legally framed shares of the effort.

Key target / provision: First statutory annual CAP; aligns actions with carbon budgets & ceilings.
Trade-offs / notes: Begins legally required annual updating.

Key target / provision: Refines measures to deliver budgets & ceilings.
Trade-offs / notes: Builds on CAP23.

Key target / provision: Renewables share raised to 43% by 2030; renewable electricity (RES-E) 80% by 2030.
Trade-offs / notes: Aligns national plan with raised EU renewables ambition.

Key target / provision: Long-term fund (€4bn by end-2025) for emissions, water-quality & biodiversity projects.
Trade-offs / notes: Channels fiscal surplus into decarbonisation & nature.

Key target / provision: Third statutory annual update; read with CAP24; detailed implementation focus.
Trade-offs / notes: Latest roadmap to halve emissions by 2030.
